Game Overview

Pirate Kid puts players into a adventure experience centered on set sail on a thrilling seaside journey as a daring pirate youngster. Navigate treacherous shores, gather glittering diamonds, and outwit pesky crabs and birds. Master the art of single and double jumps to dodge hazards and become the ultimate treasure collector. How high can your riches grow?

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Pirate Kid is easy to pick up. Set sail on a thrilling seaside journey as a daring pirate youngster!
